info.name: Klutch Public API
info.description:
Welcome to the Klutch API

The Klutch API is your gateway to integrating with Klutch, a platform designed to help users manage and automate their scheduling, availability, and time coordination. Whether you're building a personal integration or a full-featured miniapp for others, the Klutch API gives you the tools to create seamless, time-saving experiences.

What is Klutch?

Klutch helps users stay in control of their time. With smart scheduling, streamlined calendar integrations, and powerful automation, Klutch simplifies how people book, manage, and share their availability. The API enables you to tap into this power programmatically — either for yourself or on behalf of other users through miniapps.

About the API

The Klutch API is built on GraphQL, offering a flexible and efficient way to query and mutate data. Whether you need to fetch availability, create booking links, or manage user preferences, you can do it all with simple, precise queries.

Using the API

There are two primary ways to interact with the Klutch API:

1. As a User

Use this mode if you're integrating Klutch into your own workflows or building a tool for personal use.

  • Authenticate with your personal Klutch account.

  • Access and manage your own data (e.g., availability, bookings, settings).

  • Great for automating scheduling or integrating Klutch into your personal tools.

2. As a Miniapp Developer

Use this mode if you're building a miniapp for others to use. Your miniapp will authenticate on behalf of users and act in their context.

  • Register your miniapp with Klutch.

  • Once authorized, your miniapp can:

    • Create cards on behalf of users

    • Read Transactions

    • Create Spending Controls

This mode is perfect for startups, productivity tools, or any app that wants to offer Klutch’s functionality to its users.

Endpoints

We offer two endpoints: Production and Sandbox.

Users can acccess their own data using the production endpoint.

Sandbox endpoint is available for Mini-app developers if they need to test from a multi-user perspective.

Production: https://graphql.klutchcard.com/graphql

Sandbox: https://sandbox.klutchcard.com/graphql

item.name: Auth
item.description:
To create an API Key, login to your account and go to " My Account" -> "Developers"

If you are creating a mini-app, the API Key will be provided to you by our team.

graphql.query:
query {
          transactions {
            id
            transactionDate
            card {
              id
            }
            transactionStatus
            transactionType
            merchantName
            amount
            category {
              id
              name
            }
            mcc {
              code
              description
              category
            }
            zipCode
            streetAddress
            city
            state
            merchantId
            cardPresent
            cardHolderPresent
            entryMode
            terminalType
            terminalId
            merchantLogo
            mid
            merchantOfficialPage
            merchantPhoneNumber
            cardAcceptorId
          }
        }

request.description:
List Transactions

Fetch all transactions for an user

Field Descriptions:
Returns:
Field Description
id Transaction Id
transactionDate The transaction Date
card Properties of the card (see List Cards)
transactionStatus Status of the transaction
transactionType Type of Transaction
merchantName The merchant name
NOTE: That can be changed as the transaction is enriched or settled
amount Amount in USD
Note: This can changed when transaction is settled or reversed
category Properties of category (see List Categories)
mcc The Merchant Category Code
zipCode Zip Code of the merchant
streetAddress The street address of the merchant
city The city of the merchant
state The state of the merchant
merchantId Merchant Id
cardPresent Was the card present for the transaction
cardHolderPresent Was the user present for this transaction
entryMode Entry Mode for Transaction
terminalType The type of Merchant Terminal
terminalId Id of the Merchant Terminal
merchantLogo Logo of the merchant
mid Merchant Id
merchantOfficialPage The website or other official page of the merchant
merchantPhoneNumber Phone number of the merchant
cardAcceptorId The Id of the device that accepted the payment

Value Description

REVERSED The authorization was reversed

request.description:
Create Payment

Create a new payment for your card. There are three possible type of payment: Outstanding Balance, Minimum Due and a Fixed Amount (has to be greater than $15.00 or the minimum due).

When called this will initiate an ACH from the transfer source to pay the card.

Field Descriptions:
Field Description
transferSourceId Id of the transfer source
type Type of Payment: Minimum Due, Fixed Amount or Outstanding Balance
amount The amount to be paid (only for Fixed Amount)
Returns:
Field Description
id Payment Id
paymentStatus The status of the payment
paymentType The payment Type
amount The amount paid
PaymentType:
Value Description
OUTSTANDING_BALANCE The outstanding balance
MINIMUM_DUE The minimum due
OTHER_FIXED_AMOUNT Another fixed amount (greater than $15.00 or the minimum due)
PaymentStatus:
Value Description
PENDING The payment is pending
SENT The payment is sent to our processor
PROCESSING The payment was received by our processor and they are processing it
PROCESSED The payment is completed
ERROR An error occurred when sending this payment
DECLINED The payment was declined
WAITING_RELEASE We are waiting to relase this payment

List Transfer Sources

List all transfer sources for this user.

Returns:
Field Description
id Id of the transfer source
name The source name
status The transferSource Status
Status:
Value Description
PENDING The source is not yet valid
ACTIVE The source is valid for payments
DELETED The source has been deleted
